newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tristate proposes privatisation plan.
newsitem.headline: Tristate proposes privatisation plan.

text.p: Tristate Holdings Ltd said on Friday that its controlling shareholders had proposed a privatisation plan under which minority shareholders would receive HK$4.80 in cash for each Tristate share held.
The controlling shareholders currently hold 79.62 million shares, or 64.3 percent of Tristate's issued share capital, the garment manufacturer said in a statement.
It said executive director Wu Ching Her has 1.64 million shares, or 1.32 percent of the company's issued share capital, and will not include his shares in the proposal

After the offer, stock held by minority shareholders would be cancelled and controlling shareholders would own about 98 percent of the reduced issued share capital and Wu about two percent. An application would be made to withdraw Tristate's listing on the Hong Kong stock exchange.
Tristate said the liquidity of its shares has been low and trading conditions of the group depressed over the past two years.
"To maintain its existing level of profit margins, the directors believe that it is important for the group to implement tight cost control measures in both production and administration," it said.

"The directors believe that the costs and management resources associated with the maintenance of the company's listing status on the stock exchange have not been justified by the benefits to the company."
Tristate said the directors did not intend to declare a final dividend for the year ended December 31, 1996.
The privatisation scheme is expected to become effective on or before April 30, Tristate said.

The controlling shareholders are Bligh Ltd, Oscar L. Tang Family Trust, Victor Tang Trust, the Tang Fund and the Tang Foundation. The acquisition of the minority holdings, valued at about HK$204 million, would be financed mainly by an unsecured loan from the Oscar L. Tang Family Trust and bank borrowings.
Tristate shares fell HK$0.10 to close at HK$4.40 on Thursday.
